constraints.historical_evidence: Preserved separately; no old failure converted into a fresh passing flight

gates.name: Authority loss and command expiry
implemented: Unexpected disarm or unknown armed state during flight ends the owner and prevents further commands and targets.
Disarm before native landing acknowledgement cannot be reported as successful landing.
Normal acknowledged AUTO_LAND completion remains supported.
gates.evidence_limits: ROS checks use real RefNav callbacks and private publishers with synthetic state. They do not prove PX4 airborne fallback behavior.
remaining_steps: Measure native owner status and landed-message cadence against its 300 ms freshness limit; reconcile the safety latency budget before changing any threshold.
Build a bounded authority/expiry trial harness that records lease creation, expiry, last command, takeover, native PX4 mode, landing acknowledgement and disarm in causal order.
Test the harness offline and disarmed, including absent and delayed status, stale held target and explicit mode takeover.
Present exact candidate, fault times, limits, recovery owner and fresh-world preflight for approval before any moving trial.
Run approved native PX4 takeover and lease-expiry trials separately, stopping on the first failure. Do not force disarm in the air.
gates.closure: No target or command after authority loss or expiry; independently recorded native PX4 fallback and recovery within approved bounds, including landing within 30 seconds.

gates.name: Native sensing and integrated strategy shadow
implemented: Integrated sensing and four strategy implementations with pinned model artifacts in the simulator archive.
Added a bounded simulation-only clock fence that retains original source and callback stamps and records later ingestion time.
Aligned simulated estimator flag freshness with the existing 1.25 second sensor contract; hardware and visual tracking retain their tighter checks.
Preserved experimental strategy execution restrictions and all unknown-space refusals.
gates.result: Each final native replay reaches 14 planner assessments without clock errors or model fallback, but all refuse unverified progress. Synthetic positive cases are not native positive qualification.
gates.evidence_limits: Final replay uses a labeled uncertainty sensitivity profile, not independently measured flight bounds. Recorded ROS time supplies replay pacing; the separate ROS clock probe checks a real monotonic timeout. The final publication-stamp extension has offline regression coverage but is newer than that ROS probe.
remaining_steps: Independently establish camera, TF, tracking, alignment and depth uncertainty bounds and document their provenance.
Acquire legitimate observations covering the whole launch and initial stopping volume; never insert an invented free-space bubble.
Repeat the identical native recording through all four strategies with the reviewed profile and complete clock audit.
Require at least one supported positive candidate in observed clearance, plus refusal for unknown, expired, occupied and insufficient-clearance cases.
Retain shadow-only restrictions on strategies that lack their own execution qualification.
gates.closure: Reviewed native profile produces both a positive observed-clearance decision and expected negative decisions, with model identities, clock provenance and command-publisher absence recorded.

gates.name: Measured stopping and whole-drone clearance
implemented: Added a stopping envelope combining full-body radius and height, reaction distance and measured braking distance.
Checks apply on the first proposal and on held-target revalidation, including stopping clearance in every direction.
Unknown, expired, occupied or out-of-bounds clearance refuses execution.
Native activation requires an explicit envelope and measurement-file identity; no default measurement is supplied.
gates.evidence_limits: A matching file hash establishes identity, not measurement validity. There is no reviewed braking report or approved body envelope yet.
remaining_steps: Measure or verify complete vehicle dimensions including protrusions and establish a surveyed clear calibration lane.
Implement and offline-test a dedicated calibration harness with a single motion owner, bounded duration, causal timestamps and independent position/velocity recording.
Propose separate simulator calibration trials at 0.20, 0.35 and at most 0.50 m/s; choose lane length and stopping limits from surveyed clearance before requesting approval.
Approve recovery and landing behavior before movement; maintain the 30 second landing timeout and stop on the first failure.
Measure worst-case command-to-brake delay and stopping distance with uncertainty and repeatability margins; bind the reviewed report and envelope to the candidate.
Verify full-body and braking-volume clearance against narrow, low-overhead, unknown and expired-map cases before permitting policy-owned motion.
gates.closure: Reviewed measured envelope covers the requested speed and operating conditions, and native trials demonstrate safe stopping and landing within its bounds.

integration_order: Freeze source and evidence identities; retain baseline and failure folders separately.
Resolve authority cadence and finish the disarmed authority/expiry harness.
Establish reviewed sensing uncertainty and native positive shadow clearance.
Prepare the stopping calibration harness and a concrete bounded moving-trial approval package.
Run only approved trials with independent recording and first-failure stop.
Review all three gate records against the same candidate before staged policy motion; passing simulator checks does not qualify hardware.
recovery_plan: On lost authority or stale state, stop the owner issuing commands; do not fight an external owner.
Use the approved native PX4 fallback or designated recovery owner, never multiple simultaneous command owners.
On any limit breach, missing recording, failed acknowledgement or timeout, stop the batch and preserve raw data before diagnosis.
Confirm landed and disarmed from fresh native telemetry before reset or another trial.
After a fix, produce a new pinned candidate and evidence folder; retain the original failed trial and any offline reanalysis separately.
